ieee_paper.title: Machine Learning-Based Image Analysis for Cotton Crop Health: A Comparative Study
ieee_paper.venue: 2025 2nd International Conference On Multidisciplinary Research and Innovations in Engineering (MRIE)
ieee_paper.abstract: Cotton is one of India's major cash crops, contributing significantly to the agricultural economy and supporting millions of farmers. However, cotton crops are highly susceptible to various diseases and pests, which adversely impact yield and quality. This research evaluates multiple deep learning models, including Inception V3, VGG-16, ResNet 50, VGG-19, and EfficientNetV2-L, for cotton disease classification and pest identification. The study employs data augmentation techniques to address class imbalance and enhance model performance. The Inception V3 model demonstrated the highest accuracy, achieving 98.83% for disease classification and 98.72% for pest identification, followed closely by VGG-16 and VGG-19, while ResNet 50 and EfficientNetV2-L underperformed in comparison. These findings underscore the efficacy of deep learning in smart agriculture and provide insights into optimal model selection for real-world applications. The results highlight the potential of AI-driven solutions in improving cotton crop management, leading to higher yields and sustainable farming practices.
